name: game_arena_initialize
comment: Allocates one block of 0x01FFE000 minus the 0x00847000 heap start plus 0xA000, less 0x100; the arena ends at (block end - 0x20) aligned down to 16, where it writes the end node.

name: game_main_task
comment: Main loop on the state object gp-0x68C0: 1 soft reset, 2 logos 0x0017E4F0, 3 0x0017E8A0, 4 title menu 0x0017E9D0 (builds the fade object gp-0x68EC), 5 0x0017F8C0, 6 new_game_start, 7 load 0x00241480, 8 game_scene_update. Enters state 2 at 0x0017D9A4.

name: fighter_voice_event_list
comment: Alternate list for ID 1/31 with effect 0xD, 2 with 0xE, 3 with 0x10, 20 with 0x21; pairs at 0x00381A50.

name: fighter_play_voice_event
comment: Events 0..35: list from fighter_voice_event_list -> battle_voice_control(program, character, position); events 0x1B/0x1C rate-limited by +0x6A (60).

name: fighter_voice_pseudo_event
comment: -2/-3/-4 random groups 6..8/3..5/0..2, draw 3 silent; events 0..0x23; 0x1B/0x1C share cooldown +0x6A.

name: fighter_play_action_sfx
comment: action_sfx_map[selector] to audio_request_common_position.

name: fighter_apply_stat_growth
comment: Save-based per-character stat upgrades toward fixed caps (offense +0xB0 to 3.0 etc.).

name: fighter_load_character_record
comment: Copies 52 record words (+0x00..+0xCC) to fighter +0x70..+0x13C; action count from record +0x28 to +0x7E8, actions from +0x30 or +0x2C to +0x800/+0x7F8, animation count/names/working from +0x38/+0x3C/+0x40, named handles from +0x44/+0x48.

name: fighter_load_assets
comment: Resolves animation names in the body/shared providers; empty names and jutsu slots 0x48..0x4F stay zero (NA2 0x46..0x4D).

name: jutsu_connection_start
comment: Starts director event 5 with both fighters and the level; requests presentation selector 13 + level.

name: fighter_current_action_index
comment: Major-8 current action index, jutsu indices 0..3 remapped; else -1.

name: actions_setup_working_array
comment: Copies 0x58-byte actions to fighter +0x800; actions 0..3 from configured selectors +0x154/+0x156 (parity swaps pairs, continuation +-2, +0x56 = +-4, +0x20 jutsu nibble 1/2) and binds reserved slots 0x48..0x4A/0x4B/0x4C..0x4E/0x4F from the owner's names; selector 1 copies the null action.

name: fighter_motion_event_due
comment: Negative motion event resolves against animation frames-1 minus start only (NA2 prefers a positive condition).

name: response_choose_facing
comment: Uses fixed 0.75 contact-width factor (NA2 record +0x3C x0.5); flags 0x40000 keeps the direct side.

name: hit_effect_chakra_debit
comment: Non-jutsu hit: debit = (record +0x2A guard selector %5 +1) * effect_hit_chakra_debit_maximum * base, capped by receiver chakra.

name: fighter_power_up_action
comment: Shared three-level power-up: phase 2 spends action cost (+0x18) and applies the status effect with its table lifetime, plus aura particles 0x001BC7E0.

name: hit_resolve_pair
comment: Trade requires attacker flags without 0x10000 and 0x20000000 (NA2 0x2000000 and 0x4000).

name: hit_classify_pair
comment: Flags 0x4000 = guard bypass (NA2 0x800000); capture_bypasses_guard first.

name: fighter_attack_banks_enable
comment: Enables attack banks 1 and 2 at fighter +0xA38.

name: fighter_attack_banks_disable
comment: Disables attack banks 1 and 2 at fighter +0xA38.

name: fighter_register_attack_window
comment: Negative bounds resolve against positive condition else frames-1, as NA2.

name: hit_admit_response
comment: Receiver-side hit admission by mode 0/1/2: record flag 0x4000 (with guard) sets guard -1, 0x2000 sets guard 0 (NA2 0x400000), 0x8000 guarded variant; then ordinary or guard response.

name: receiver_retained_hit_count
comment: Receiver hit count read by byakugan_hinata_hit_response.

name: fighter_has_chakra
comment: True when fighter +0x5C >= the given amount, unless 0x001EC4E0 reports a block.

name: guard_enter_response
comment: Guard selector short +0x2A (+5 airborne), update pause +0x32, rejection +0x34.

name: substitution_attack_admits
comment: Rejects record flags 0x10000 or 0x40000000 (NA2 0x2000000|0x8000); timing word +0x14 (NA2 byte +0x1A).

name: fighter_movement_speed_update
comment: Movement actions by +0x15A: 0x11/0x10/0x0F ease speed +0x754; 0x0E (ACT_RUN_0) also runs fighter_periodic_surface_effects with the run's frame (+0x174).

name: response_select_substate
comment: Short response selector at record +0x28 to UN2 response states 0x27..0x51; guard bypass gives 0x47 (GBR); callback slot 0xC first.

name: fighter_knockdown_landing
comment: Damage states 0x3A..0x3D landing transitions; a contact word with bit 0x400 doubles the landing damage and calls the stage event 0x002E9970 through 0x0081BFA0.

name: hit_rehit_allowed
comment: Record flags 0x1000, or flags 1 and 0x40 outside category 0xF000 (NA2 hit_response_gate_bits: 0x200000, or 1 and 0x10 outside 0xF00000).

name: action_select_record
comment: Ordinary scan of 0x58-byte actions: skips categories 2, 0xF0, 0xF000; signature +0x20, continuation short +0x1C; signature 0x01000000 tests category-2 records (NA2 0x02000000/slot 19).

name: action_dispatch_index
comment: Debits cost +0x18 for categories outside 0xF000; flags 0x20000 skips Ultimate Jutsu admission checks and statistics (NA2 0x10000).

name: action_update_jutsu_record
comment: Routes category 0xC00 (NA2 0xC0000), 0xC (NA2 0xF00), 2 and flags 2 like NA2; ordinary path passes row +8 to response_motion_update.

name: capture_bypasses_guard
comment: Capture classification with flags 0x20000000 (NA2 0x4000).

name: capture_update_motion
comment: Category 4 phase 0 facing requires action +0x1E == 0 (NA2 flags 0x40); category 8 phase 1 reversal unless flags 0x40000.

name: capture_update_sender_grounding
comment: Flags 0x40000 with category 8 = NA2 flags 0x04000000 with 0x200; reads streak short +0x1E where NA2 reads streak_exempt.

name: capture_compute_approach
comment: Behavior mask 0xFF0 (NA2 0x7C).

name: action_build_chain_masks
comment: Chain categories 0x10/0x20/0x40, mode-1 flag group 0xF00000, exchange group 0x0F000000.

name: battle_director_jutsu
comment: Director event 5: after the film applies jutsu_damage_total to the defender through the damage calculator (flag 0x100), Practice floor 0.01, then restores both fighters.

name: effect_stage_intensity_tint_update
comment: Reads stage_effect_intensity[scene byte +0x41] and passes it to the mode-2 tint packet 0x001E04E0; UN3's effect_4a_secondary_update reads its table the same way but defaults out-of-range scenes.

name: sealed_orochimaru_create
comment: Allocates 0x1D30 bytes and calls sealed_orochimaru_construct.

name: sealed_orochimaru_construct
comment: Base fighter constructor, vtable 0x00550F40, record +0x40 = fighter +0xAF0 (animation lookup), +0x30 = fighter +0xD60 (working actions), then fighter_load_character_record.

name: sealed_orochimaru_destroy
comment: Common fighter teardown; frees for a positive flag.

name: sealed_orochimaru_update_ai
comment: Calls shared BATTLE ai_fighter_update (0x00746150) while control bits 5..8 are nonzero; returns 0. Same shape in every fighter vtable.

name: sealed_orochimaru_channel2
comment: Actions 43..45 -> fighter_power_up_action(level, effect 0x2F+level); frame SFX 0x41/effects on combo actions.

name: sealed_orochimaru_response_override
comment: Slot 3: action 27 later hits NLH/BD, 18 HOL2, 17 random NSH/NMH/NML or NAS, 7 BSB (knockback 1.5) then NB15 (0.75), 6 later hits NB12; else -1.

name: sealed_orochimaru_neck_throw_head
comment: Slot 4: during actions 20/21 rewrites OBJ_2cmn00t0 head's matrix and marks it modified.

name: fighter_id_031_create
comment: Allocate 0x1C30 and run nine_tailed_naruto_construct.

name: nine_tailed_naruto_construct
comment: Common base 0x001875C0, vtable 0x00550EE0 at +0x48, working animation array +0xAF0, working actions +0xD64, then fighter_load_character_record.

name: nine_tailed_naruto_action_update
comment: Callback slot 2: actions 40/41/42 phase 1 cursor 7 sound 30/36/30 and voice 6/7/8; action 8 cursor 17 sound 33.

name: nine_tailed_naruto_response_override
comment: Callback slot 3: action 21 -> 0x3C (BR); repeat>1: 12 -> 0x30, 7 -> 0x32, 8 phase0 random 0x29/0x2A ground else 0x2E, later 0x33.

name: byakugan_hinata_create
comment: ID 33 factory: allocate 0x1AF0 (base 0xAF0 + 144 names + 40 actions), byakugan_hinata_construct.

name: byakugan_hinata_construct
comment: Base fighter, vtable byakugan_hinata_vtable, descriptor copy, working names fighter+0xAF0 / actions +0xD30, fighter_load_character_record.

name: byakugan_hinata_destroy
comment: Deleting destructor; restores base vtable 0x00550D00 and releases common members.

name: byakugan_hinata_com_update
comment: Vtable +0x1C: COM level (fighter +0x50 bits 5..8) nonzero -> BATTLE AI update 0x00746150; same body as Hinata's 0x001CE2C0.

name: byakugan_hinata_channel2
comment: Callback slot 2: actions 37..39 -> fighter_self_buff_special(level, effect 0x38+level); action 14 primary event 7 and action 10 events 0x12/0x16 phase writes.

name: byakugan_hinata_hit_response
comment: Callback slot 3: action 12 -> 0x30; actions 7/10 by receiver hit count (<2: 0x3C, +0x75C 1.0; else 0x30, +0x75C 0.5 / 0.25); -1 otherwise.

name: status_effect_node_construct
comment: Copies the definition row into node +0x58..+0x94; f8 != 1 plays SFX 0x4E and rescales.

name: fighter_apply_status_effect
comment: Classes by id 0..12/13..58/59..73; lifetime -1 argument uses the table lifetime.

name: effect_attack_factor
comment: Additive f0, cap 2.0.

name: effect_defense_factor
comment: Additive f1, floor 0.25.

name: effect_action_rate_factor
comment: Additive f2, cap 1.25; neutral in majors 5/6 and gated in major 8.

name: effect_jump_height_factor
comment: Additive f3; scales record jump heights.

name: effect_hit_chakra_debit_maximum
comment: Maximum f6; used by the hit chakra debit 0x00190360.

name: effect_knockback_factor
comment: Additive f7; attacker scale on receiver knockback in 0x0018D070.

name: fighter_apply_post_jutsu_effect
comment: Applies a nonzero effect with lifetime -1 through fighter_apply_status_effect.

name: jutsu_animation_archive_name
comment: Word 0 of jutsu_animation_provider_table row.

name: jutsu_selector_character
comment: Positive selector>>1, else 0.

name: camera_bind_stage_record
comment: Save camera +0x17C and bind stage_camera_records_by_scene[scene] there without a range check; UN3 counterpart 0x00234D80 (+0x18C).

name: phase_event_completion
comment: Row condition -1 end, -2 grounded, -3 descending/grounded, -4 end or grounded, -5 end and grounded (NA2 -16..-20); positive cursor; 0 hold; no relative jump.

name: fighter_event_dispatch
comment: Event 0x8002 publishes the masked ground code; the tail writes manager +0x2B68 = 0xF0F0F0.

name: knockout_screen_effect_begin
comment: Called only through knockout_screen_effect_start from battle_director_knockout state 0. Builds the 0x44-byte effect object, sets draw environment 0x00561460 to priority 0 on scene 9 (else reinserts manager +0x2440 at its priority) and moves actors with flag 0x10 to layer 3, saving their layer.

name: knockout_screen_effect_end
comment: Destroys the effect object, reinserts manager +0x2440 at priority 1 and restores the saved actor layers.

name: effect_emit_surface_puffs
comment: Smoke variant 0x95 for snow/ice, else 0x93; scenes 16/17 add three particles of the stage's EFF_e0x_ice.

name: fighter_periodic_surface_effects
comment: By fighter +0x8C0 & 0xF0F0F0 and cursor: 0xE0A000 splash 0x0021F9F0 every 10 (state 4) or 2 updates after 6; 0xF0D0D0/0xF0F0F0/0x5000/0x606060/0x80D0F0/0x90B0C0/0x3060 puff 0x0021C370 at scale 4 below 8, then 2.5 every 10 (state 4) or 4; 0x90B0C0 also 0x00224010 at the lower foot; 0xD000, 0x60C0, 0x202020, 0xE0E000 nothing.

name: effect_emit_periodic_water_code
comment: Every 15 cursor units: 0xE0A000 splash 0x0021F9F0; 0xE0E000 0x0021F7E0 (effect 0x2E, ANM_e0x_move_02).

name: effect_emit_manager_ground_code
comment: Manager +0x2B68: snow/ice effect 0x40, other ground codes 0x28, then shared feedback and common sound 0x23; 0x60C0 returns.

name: knockout_screen_effect_start
comment: knockout_screen_effect_begin on the battle manager, then BATTLE.BIN 0x007577C0(0).

name: knockout_screen_effect_stop
comment: knockout_screen_effect_end on the battle manager, then BATTLE.BIN 0x007577F0(0); battle_director_knockout calls it after 31 updates.

name: stage_break_debris_parse
comment: Equals UN3 stage_break_debris_parse: four token-7 pieces ('%s_a%d'), 20 particles, gravity 9.8, bounce 0.6, damping 0.8.

name: stage_emit_feedback
comment: Numeric stage feedback dispatch, then a nonnegative common sound.

name: battle_manager_construct
comment: Builds the manager; battle_manager_defaults sets its fields.

name: battle_manager_defaults
comment: Scene index +0x41 0, P1/P2 character +0x42/+0x43 1/2, COM flags +0x46/+0x47 0, active side +0x26C 0 (constructor); profile +0x58 Practice Behavior 1, +0x5D bits 0..4 set.

name: battle_mode_support_gate
comment: 1 except mode 6 (context +0x287 bit 0) and modes 1/4 (bit 0 of mode record +0x5D); gates the support points.

name: battle_setting_flag1_set
comment: Bit 1 of profile byte +0x5D (mode 6: +0x287). Not Command Display: fighter setup 0x00188F60 sets fighter +0x140 while it is clear, and a BATTLE.BIN COM routine (0x00739A60 area) acts only while it is set.

name: battle_setting_flag1_get
comment: Bit 1 of profile byte +0x5D in modes 1 and 4, +0x287 in mode 6, 0 in modes 5 and 8, else 1.

name: practice_behavior_set
comment: Behavior (MANUAL 0): mode 1 stores profile byte +0x58, mode 6 +0x282. The Practice Settings commit applies it through practice_toggle_com.

name: practice_behavior_get
comment: Mode 1 profile byte +0x58, mode 6 +0x282, otherwise 1.

name: practice_command_display_set
comment: Command Display: bit 2 of profile byte +0x5D (mode 6: +0x287).

name: practice_command_display_get
comment: Bit 2 of profile byte +0x5D in mode 1 (default 1), +0x287 in mode 6, else 1. BATTLE.BIN 0x006AB970 shows and fades the Practice command rows only while it is set.

name: battle_mode_intruders_enabled
comment: Returns bit 3 of byte +0x5D of the mode object's +4 record; gates the 0x990 intruding characters.

name: new_game_start
comment: Builds battle_manager (0x2F4 bytes) with defaults and loads Battle.bin. Outside state 5, a -1 from 0x00263150 runs a Home.bin sequence and sets money to 50000; then fades and returns 1.

name: game_scene_update
comment: Dispatches battle_manager scene +0x38: 0 mode_select_scene_update; 1 by mode +0x3C (1 practice_mode_update, 4 battle 0x00244590, 5 0x00246900, 6 Ultimate Contest 0x00242CC0); 2, 3, 4; 5 returns to the title.

name: mode_select_scene_update
comment: States 0..3 load the menu; state 4 runs it (0x00296110, result 0x00296390); state 6 maps result 1 to scene 1 mode 1 (Practice), 2/3 to scenes 2/3, 4 to mode 4 with its control mode, 6 to mode 6, 7 to scene 4 mode 7, -1 to scene 5.

name: practice_mode_update
comment: Mode 1, states by table 0x004B8A70: 0 control mode +0x40 (1: P2 COM +0x47; 2 with +0x26C set: P1 COM +0x46); 1 loads charsel1, mapsel1, mcmn, prac, pirk, itya; 2 Character Select (result 1 finalizes loadouts); 4 Stage Select, result scene in +0x41.

name: mode_queue_files
comment: Queues a mode's files (-1: the manager's mode) and starts loading: mode 1 prac.ccs and rpg/pirk.ccs, then, as mode 4, mcmn, charsel1, mapsel1, setting and itya; 2, 3 and 6 their own.

name: audio_request_common_position
comment: Read an audio_common_controls row and emit positional synth commands; event 0xCE suppressed here.

name: audio_request_common_position_key
comment: Common positional request with a supplied key.

name: audio_request_archive_member
comment: Checks family/bank/member count against descriptor lists 0x00419B40, then starts the member.

name: audio_load_common_bank
comment: Load DATA/SNDDATA.BIN per audio_common_bank_descriptor and bind it through RPC 0x9050.

name: audio_load_character_bank
comment: Loads audio_character_banks[character - 1] for a side (RPC 0x9400, bind 0x9056+side) and stores the index at context +0x9C/+0x9D.

name: audio_bind_skill_cues
comment: Binds sp_skill_cue_descriptors[row] to the audio context (+0x130/+0x134) and stores the row (+0x13C).

name: audio_write_pending_stream
comment: Row = slot*0x14: bank = character - 1, member, slot, alternate family, pending 1.

name: sp_skill_play_frame
comment: Per-frame: part script (type 1/2/3 commands: create/destroy helper, participant face swap) and position samples; no hits or damage.

name: sp_skill_play_begin
comment: Per played part: binds participants, begins the contest stage for this part with window = stage row window adjusted +-30 by HP gap and ended at least 90 frames before the part's last frame; loads part position samples.

name: sp_skill_build_requests
comment: Resident 0x1000, extras 0x1000, then each part's own stream (first 0x400); nonzero start part queues that part alone.

name: sp_skill_play_start
comment: Builds the SP Skill Play task from sp_skill_table row; checks extra bodies; start part from param_7 high half.

name: sp_skill_play_current_part
comment: Returns the play task's part ordinal (+0x76), current frame and stream identifier (BCD of DCC_L_P name digits).

name: ccs_stream_player_run
comment: Stream player task: prepares the row's soundtrack (0x00261290), loads residents, streams parts, destroys loaded containers.

name: jutsu_camera_apply_preset_record
comment: Installs a 0xB0-byte camera preset's tracking sources, positions, offsets and controls.

name: stage_rectangle_x_offset
comment: Walks the current scene's stage_scene_rectangle_lists for records matching the given section; for the first rectangle containing the position returns the x offset to its edge chosen by the record's side byte, else 0.

name: actor_target_rectangle_x_offset
comment: stage_rectangle_x_offset for the fighter selected by actor +0x124 and the section at +0x7A6 of the actor's fighter; called from actor updates at 0x00278618 (state 7, added to the fighter's x before placing it) and 0x0027A39C.

name: support_points_assign
comment: Gives the stage control's 0xC0A points (+0x214, count +0x20C, token 0 +0x210) to the two per-side support actors when 0x0023BE30 passes and battle mode +0x3C is not 1.

name: support_set_points
comment: Copies the points 2 higher to +0x268 with types at +0x290 (first token-0 type 1, rest type 2), count +0x298, token 0 +0x29C.

name: support_appear_at_point
comment: Stands the support at a random 0xC0A point other than the other side's (+0x294), on section type - 1 (+0x130), and picks its attack (0x00283430).

name: mode_select_menu_confirm
comment: Confirm (1) queues the item's mode files through mode_queue_files with the mode from 0x004F2C50 unless +0xBB is set; cancel (-1) stores 0xFFFF.

name: particle_field_apply
comment: Reads the field's original descriptor (+4) when override +0xC is zero; UN3 copies descriptors instead.

name: particle_generator_construct
comment: Builds a 0x130 generator from a 0x38 descriptor and up to four fields (default fields from descriptor +0x30 rows); sets +4 bit 0 (per-particle distance fade), +0x30 scale 1, alpha +0x108/+0x10C 1, fade squares 400^2 +0x114, 50^2 +0x118, 4000^2 +0x11C, 5000^2 +0x120.

name: particle_generator_start
comment: Sets +0x100 to 1.

name: particle_distance_fade
comment: Particle alpha by squared camera distance when its +4 bit 3 (the generator's +4 bit 0) is set: 0 outside +0x118..+0x120, ramps in to +0x114 and out from +0x11C.

name: generator_resolve_resources
comment: Resolve each generator_resource_rows row's container and resource into the pool lookup array.

name: random_int_inclusive
comment: Unsigned random modulo maximum+1.

name: random_float_signed
comment: Signed random32 / 2^31 times the amplitude: -a..a.

name: audio_stream_channel_play
comment: Starts a streamed archive member on a stereo stream channel (channel, file family/gain, member, ...).

name: battle_control_mask_active
comment: True when mask +0x64 and latch +0x60 are both nonzero.

name: glare_pass_initialize
comment: Mode 1, colour 0xA0808080, second colour 0xFFFFFF, amount -0.1 (NA2 pause_auxiliary_refresh).

name: glare_pass_draw
comment: Downsamples the frame 256/128/64, blurs back up, subtracts amount x 255 of the second colour, then blends the result over the frame with mode +0x81 and colour +0x84.

name: audio_character_bank_descriptor
comment: &audio_character_banks[index]; index is character ID - 1.

name: audio_load_battle_character_banks
comment: Loads both sides' banks from battle manager +0x42/+0x43 character IDs minus one.

name: audio_apply_music_preset
comment: Preset 5 plays the context +0x1AC override, or stage_music_tracks[scene] from SOUND.AFS partition 0 through 0x0025DA30.

name: audio_consume_pending_streams
comment: Alternate 0: PLVOICE family 3 by bank; else SOUND family 0 with the alternate as bank.

name: audio_queue_player_voice
comment: Character below 34: queues a PLVOICE cue with bank = character - 1 through audio_write_pending_stream.

name: audio_queue_support_voice
comment: Character below 40: SOUND bank 2 member from support_voice_rows, skipped when battle manager +0x3C is 1.

name: battle_voice_control
comment: Plays battle_voice_controls[control] (program, key) on the side's compact bank.

name: audio_request_surface_word
comment: Mask a supplied polygon word and use the periodic surface event map.

name: audio_emit_cinematic_defender_cue
comment: Plays battle_voice_controls[control] (0..144) on the defender side's compact bank when that bank holds the defender.

name: audio_emit_cinematic_mode_cue
comment: Film-viewer cue: key byte 0..12 selects a row of 0x00419700; program is defender ID - 1.

name: audio_prepare_skill_cues
comment: Binds the row's cue rows and moves the cue cursor (+0x144) past rows before the current part.

name: audio_prepare_skill_soundtrack
comment: Stops music, binds cue rows and, when part 1 has a soundtrack member, requests music preset 9 (part 1 track on channel 1, paused).

name: audio_skill_soundtrack_frame_update
comment: At frame 1 of part 1 unpauses the track; at frame 1 of a later part starts that part's STR.AFS member on channel 1; emits cue rows whose frame and part match.

name: character_has_stat_growth
comment: 0 for IDs 29..33 (list 0x004412C0), else 1.

name: jutsu_contest_construct
comment: Contest: attacker side +0x18, IDs +0x19/+0x1A, level +0x1E, stage +0x1B, mode +0x1C6C from jutsu_contest_modes; clears jutsu_damage_total.

name: jutsu_contest_resolve
comment: When both sides finish a stage, adds jutsu_stage_damage[ID][level][stage]% (x0.66 on defender win, +bonus byte on attacker flag) to jutsu_damage_total; modes 1..3 compare counts.

name: jutsu_contest_begin_stage
comment: Stage = part index: loads both sides' input specs from jutsu_contest_stage_rows, window lengths, sets +0x1B.

name: stage_build_doll_ai_targets
comment: Training dolls (subtype 0x25) into scene +0x40C/+0x410, without the +0x148 check.

name: stage_build_breakable_ai_targets
comment: Section COM prop-target lists (scene +0x404/+0x408) from category-8 objects with +0x148 == 1.

name: stage_prepare_doll_nodes
comment: Runs after each category-3 record, as UN3's does.

name: stage_scene_construct
comment: Walk scene_index's 32-byte records from BATTLE stage_scene_tables (0x0081C760), switching on category (type bits 8..15) 0..14, then fixed setup. UN3 counterpart 0x007C26C0; unlike UN3, category 12 has a handler (0x002DB450).

name: stage_construct_training_dolls
comment: Category 8 subtype 0x25 (training dolls).

name: stage_leaf_surface_variant
comment: Leaf variant by stage +0x9C: 1->1, 6->3, 2: within 200 of x -700/700 -> 3/6 else 0 (4 without position), 11: within 200 of -825/825 -> 5/4.

name: stage_apply_render_coefficients
comment: Copy stage_render_coefficients[scene] to 0x0056DB18/0x0056DB14 (UN3 keeps its table in BATTLE.BIN).

name: stage_apply_scene_glare
comment: Loads the owner's scene (+0x9C) glare row into gp-0x6568 and the owner's glare pass +0x270; called from stage_scene_construct.

name: stage_parse_player_nodes
comment: Category 10 handler of stage_scene_construct.

name: stage_parse_line_nodes
comment: Category 11 handler of stage_scene_construct.

name: stage_parse_fog
comment: Category 1 handler of stage_scene_construct.

name: stage_parse_category2
comment: Category 2 handler of stage_scene_construct.

name: stage_parse_point_nodes
comment: Category 12 subtype 0x0A: token 5 positions of the token-3 node and its _N siblings into stage control +0x214 (count +0x20C, token 0 at +0x210). UN3 skips category 12.

name: stage_parse_lighting
comment: Category 13 handler of stage_scene_construct.

name: stage_parse_cl_lines
